items.title: How PayPal and Venmo Tuition Integrations Could Shape PayPal Holdings’ (PYPL) Commerce-Platform Ambitions
items.summary: In August 2026, PayPal Holdings announced that PayPal and Venmo can now be used to pay tuition and fees at U.S. colleges and universities through new integrations with Illumia, Nelnet Campus Commerce, and TouchNet, with services already live at institutions such as Bellarmine University, Butler University, Kansas State University, Michigan State University, and Texas Tech University.
